key_note: RFC 8032 section 7.1 TEST 1, the same key the message vectors use, chosen so the key derivation itself is checkable against a published vector. It is a TEST key and must never be used by a real agent.
note: PUBLISHED ARTIFACT. These are the exact bytes a RECIPIENT signs to acknowledge a message, and the exact detached Ed25519 signatures over them (ed25519.Sign over canonical_hex UNHASHED). Layout: the table in signing.CanonicalizeAck's doc comment. Regenerating this file to make a test pass is a WIRE-FORMAT CHANGE, not a fix -- a new format version reserved from the signing-format-version namespace, with a new context string. NOTE the signature is checked for SHAPE ONLY by every bus (relay.ValidateAckAttestation); no bus verifies it and none may claim to, and today no endpoint distributes agents' messaging public keys so a sender cannot verify it either (16 Q1).

vectors.name: delivered-local
vectors.why: positive ACK, origin bus and recipient bus coincide; the class is an EMPTY but PRESENT zero-length field

vectors.name: delivered-cross-bus
vectors.why: positive ACK across a relay hop; the two bus halves DIFFER and that is legitimate (ACK-CONTRACT.md 6.2)

vectors.name: refused-undecodable
vectors.why: reveals THAT decoding failed and nothing about the bytes that failed (invariant 6)

vectors.name: refused-not-addressed
vectors.why: the third and last recipient-emitted class
